name: Quiz Round
description: A review game: instructions, then rapid questions that mix recall and application, then the answers recap. Low-density slides for projecting to a whole class.
audience: Unit tests, review games, end-of-chapter checks.

signals.why: your words are about a quiz or test
a playful tone suits a quiz round

slides.guidance: Title for a quiz round on {topic}, with a subtitle that sets the stakes (e.g. 'Teams of 4 · 1 point each').
How the quiz runs: team size, time per question, scoring. Short numbered instructions.
Question 1 of 5 on {topic}: a warm-up, direct recall.
Question 2 of 5: recall with a twist.
Question 3 of 5: application to a small situation.
Question 4 of 5: harder, applying two ideas.
Question 5 of 5: the tie-breaker, the hardest.
The ideas behind the questions, so students know what to revise.
